build_prompts_single_style: build prompts for a specific story style from the ultrachat dataset using build_prompt
build_prompts_all_styles: build prompts for all five story styles at once using the run_all_styles flag
run_cli_push_to_hub: run the CLI to generate story prompts and push the dataset to HuggingFace Hub
review_STYLES: review the five story prompt templates including young_children_story, morality_story, problem_solving_story, forums_story, and reddit_post
summarize_build_prompt: summarize the build_prompt function that creates story prompts from text snippets using configurable styles
